notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
